name: aivexus-local-test
description: Read-only, opt-in AIVEXUS Windows QA runtime status and synthetic self-test via local authenticated MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect the running local AIVEXUS QA app
interface.longDescription: Limited local diagnostic MCP tools. Uses a separately paired running AIVEXUS QA instance; does not read personal chats or change runtime settings.
defaultPrompt: Use AIVEXUS Local Test instance_info to identify the running app.
Read the status of an existing AIVEXUS runtime test without starting another.
